values.note: $20 a site, exact cash or check only, no credit cards.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/cold-springs-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night'; '$20 per site. Exact cash or check only ... NO CREDIT CARDS accepted.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Small, popular Forest Service loop 16.5 miles from Yampa on FR 900 (7 miles of paved CR 7, then gravel), with Flat Tops Wilderness views, beside a small pond and past Yamcolo Reservoir (boat launch) and Bear Lake: site 1 is a pull-through and a 24-ft camper fits site 5, but the other three are small and a ranger calls 24 ft tight. Close to the Stillwater and Smith Lake trailheads. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov POI record: confirmed 5 sites, vault toilet, no drinking water, no electric or showers, $20 cash/check. Added season (typically June-October), booking first-come at the kiosk. Cleared the 24-ft max and pull-through: no agency page gives either. Lakeview kept: the loop sits on open ground ~10-30 m west of a small pond (imagery); pin on the loop, 30 m from the FS point. Note trimmed of price, season and amenity facts.
